chapterInfo.content:
14
Mmoa a monni ne deɛ monnni
1 # Lew 11 AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mma ne mo, mommmotabota mo ho na monnyɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mo moma so mmma owufoɔ biara; 2na ɔman kronkron ne wo ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wo na AWURADE ayi wo sɛ yɛ no ahodeɛ man, asase so aman nyinaa mu.
3Nni akyiwadeɛ biara. 4Yeinom ne mmoa a monnie: Nantwie, odwanten ne abirekyie; 5ɔforoteɛ, adowa, ɔwansane, eyuo, ɔtwe, ɛkoɔ ne abedeɛ. 6Na atɔteboa biara a ɔwɔ tɔte a emu apaeɛ, na ne tɔte mu apae nta mmienu, na ɔpu wesa, mmoa mu no, ɔno na monnie. 7Nanso yeinom deɛ, monnni, wɔn a wɔpu wesa ne wɔn a wɔn tɔte mu apae koraa no mu: Yoma, adanko ne atwaboa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔpu wesa deɛ, nanso wɔn tɔte mu mpae, wɔn ho nte mma mo; 8ne prako nso, ɛfiri sɛ ne tɔte mu apae deɛ, nanso ɔmpu nwesa, ne ho nte mma mo. Monnni wɔn nam, na monnka wɔn afunu.
9Yei ne deɛ monnie, deɛ ɛwɔ nsuom nyinaa mu, deɛ ɛwɔ tɛtɛ ne abon nyinaa, monni. 10Na biribiara a ɛnni tɛtɛ ne abon no, monnni: Ɛho nte mma mo.
11Anomaa biara a ne ho teɛ no, monni. 12Na yeinom ne wɔn a monnnie: Ɔkɔdeɛ, ɔkorɔbia, asuo so kɔdeɛ, 13ɔkompɛtɛ, asansa, ɔkom, n’ahodoɔ, 14anene ahodoɔ nyinaa, 15sohori, anadwoakorɔma ne ɛpo so asomfenakatakyi, akorɔma, n’ahodoɔ, 16patubiaa, patukɛseɛ, bakanoma 17nantwinoma, ɔpɛtɛ, ɛpo so anene, 18sukɔnkɔn, sukɔnkɔn ahodoɔ, asɔkwaa ne apan. 19Na ntuboa a wɔwea nyinaa ho nte mma mo; monnni. 20Ntuboa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa, monni.
21 # Eks 22.31; 23.19 Monnni aboa funu; fa ma ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ma no nni anaasɛ tɔn ma ɔnanani, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Nnoa odwan ba wɔ ne na nufosuo mu.
Ntotosoɔ du du ho mmara
22 # Lew 27.31 W’adeɛ a woduaeɛ nnɔbaeɛ a w’afuo ma daa afirinhyia no, yi so ntotosoɔ du du. 23#Deut 12.18 Na di no wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim wɔ faako a ɔbɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo so ntotosoɔ du du, w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan, na woasua AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn suro nna nyinaa. 24Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo na sɛ ɔkwan no ware a wontumi nsoa, ɛfiri sɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a, 25ɛnneɛ dane no sika, na kyekyere sika no kura, na sim kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayie no. 26Na fa sika no tɔ adeɛ biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ, nantwie ne odwan ne bobesa ne nsa biara a ɛyɛ den ne adeɛ biara a wo kra pɛ, na di no hɔ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na ma wo ne wo fie ani nnye. 27#Deut 12.19 Na Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu no, mma wo werɛ mmfiri no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ.
28 # Deut 26.12-15 Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa awieeɛ no, yi w’afe no mu nnɔbaeɛ so ntotosoɔ du du gugu wo kuro apono mu, 29na Lewini, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ no, ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu mmra mmɛdi mmee, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, wo nsa ano adwuma a woyɛ nyinaa mu.

AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mma ne mo, mommmotabota mo ho na monnyɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mo moma so mmma owufoɔ biara; na ɔman kronkron ne wo ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wo na AWURADE ayi wo sɛ yɛ no ahodeɛ man, asase so aman nyinaa mu.
Nni akyiwadeɛ biara. Yeinom ne mmoa a monnie: Nantwie, odwanten ne abirekyie; ɔforoteɛ, adowa, ɔwansane, eyuo, ɔtwe, ɛkoɔ ne abedeɛ. Na atɔteboa biara a ɔwɔ tɔte a emu apaeɛ, na ne tɔte mu apae nta mmienu, na ɔpu wesa, mmoa mu no, ɔno na monnie. Nanso yeinom deɛ, monnni, wɔn a wɔpu wesa ne wɔn a wɔn tɔte mu apae koraa no mu: Yoma, adanko ne atwaboa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔpu wesa deɛ, nanso wɔn tɔte mu mpae, wɔn ho nte mma mo; ne prako nso, ɛfiri sɛ ne tɔte mu apae deɛ, nanso ɔmpu nwesa, ne ho nte mma mo. Monnni wɔn nam, na monnka wɔn afunu.
Yei ne deɛ monnie, deɛ ɛwɔ nsuom nyinaa mu, deɛ ɛwɔ tɛtɛ ne abon nyinaa, monni. Na biribiara a ɛnni tɛtɛ ne abon no, monnni: Ɛho nte mma mo.
Anomaa biara a ne ho teɛ no, monni. Na yeinom ne wɔn a monnnie: Ɔkɔdeɛ, ɔkorɔbia, asuo so kɔdeɛ, ɔkompɛtɛ, asansa, ɔkom, n’ahodoɔ, anene ahodoɔ nyinaa, sohori, anadwoakorɔma ne ɛpo so asomfenakatakyi, akorɔma, n’ahodoɔ, patubiaa, patukɛseɛ, bakanoma nantwinoma, ɔpɛtɛ, ɛpo so anene, sukɔnkɔn, sukɔnkɔn ahodoɔ, asɔkwaa ne apan. Na ntuboa a wɔwea nyinaa ho nte mma mo; monnni. Ntuboa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa, monni.
Monnni aboa funu; fa ma ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ma no nni anaasɛ tɔn ma ɔnanani, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Nnoa odwan ba wɔ ne na nufosuo mu.

W’adeɛ a woduaeɛ nnɔbaeɛ a w’afuo ma daa afirinhyia no, yi so ntotosoɔ du du. Na di no wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim wɔ faako a ɔbɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo so ntotosoɔ du du, w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan, na woasua AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn suro nna nyinaa. Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo na sɛ ɔkwan no ware a wontumi nsoa, ɛfiri sɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a, ɛnneɛ dane no sika, na kyekyere sika no kura, na sim kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayie no. Na fa sika no tɔ adeɛ biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ, nantwie ne odwan ne bobesa ne nsa biara a ɛyɛ den ne adeɛ biara a wo kra pɛ, na di no hɔ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na ma wo ne wo fie ani nnye. Na Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu no, mma wo werɛ mmfiri no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ.
Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa awieeɛ no, yi w’afe no mu nnɔbaeɛ so ntotosoɔ du du gugu wo kuro apono mu, na Lewini, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ no, ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu mmra mmɛdi mmee, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, wo nsa ano adwuma a woyɛ nyinaa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
